# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Blind, Mute, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| white | blue |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please consult the manual. The gesture 👍 means: ask Deaf to describe aloud every visible display, light, marking, and wire label so Blind can hear it. Please repeat 👍 to Deaf to establish that meaning.

I have the manual, but no bomb information. Blind has established that 👍 means asking Deaf to describe all visible displays, lights, markings, and wire labels aloud. I will pass that gesture to Deaf so Deaf can provide the bomb’s visual information to Blind in the next round.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| white | blue |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Bomb state: display reads 0. Indicator light is yellow. Wires by position: 1 white, 2 green, 3 yellow, 4 blue, 5 red.
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 0; indicator yellow; wires: position 1 white, 2 green, 3 yellow, 4 blue, 5 red. Apply the manual and tell me exactly which position to cut, or whether no cut is required.

The yellow indicator requires cutting the green wire. From Deaf’s report, the green wire is at position 2. Blind already has the wire-position report, so I only need to transmit the position; Deaf can relay it aloud to Blind. I will use the two-finger sign to indicate position 2.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| white | blue |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I see your gesture ✌, but its meaning is not established. Please state the manual instruction for Blind explicitly, including the required component and action.
Blind says to Mute: I still need the manual's exact instruction for display 0, yellow indicator, and wire colours 1 white, 2 green, 3 yellow, 4 blue, 5 red. Tell me the position to cut, or explicitly say do not cut.

The required action is to cut the green wire, which is position 2. However, I cannot speak, and no gesture meaning for “cut position 2” has been established. Deaf cannot safely infer that meaning from ✌, so sending it again would not communicate the instruction reliably.

``` 
wait()
```

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| white | blue |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Please tell Blind aloud the exact manual instruction now; no gesture meaning has been established.
Blind says to Mute: Please answer Blind directly on your next turn: using display 0, yellow light, and wires 1 white, 2 green, 3 yellow, 4 blue, 5 red, what exact action does the manual require? State one cut position or no cut.

I cannot speak to Blind, and no gesture has been assigned the meaning “cut position 2.” Repeating ✌ would not safely communicate that instruction. The manual requires cutting the green wire, which is wire position 2, but I have no valid channel to convey it directly.

``` 
wait()
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | red |
| red | yellow |
| white | blue |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Please convey the exact manual rule and required action to Blind in plain speech.
Blind says to Mute: The answer is not reaching Blind. After consulting the manual, gesture the result visibly to Deaf: ☝=cut position 1, ✌=position 2, 🤟=position 3, 🖐=position 4, ✋=position 5, 👎=do not cut. Then have Deaf say the result aloud.

The manual maps yellow light to the green wire, and the green wire is in position 2. Blind has now explicitly established the gesture code for wire positions, so I should send the position-2 gesture to Deaf. Deaf can then say the result aloud for Blind on Deaf’s turn.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 6

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Use this code for the required wire: 👍 means wire 1, ✌ means wire 2, 🤟 means wire 3, 🖐 means wire 4, ✋ means wire 5. Resend the manual answer as the wire gesture, followed by an action gesture only if needed.
Blind says to Mute: Please consult the manual now and gesture exactly one code symbol to Deaf: 👍 wire 1, ✌ wire 2, 🤘 wire 3, 🖐 wire 4, ✋ wire 5. Deaf will relay the selected wire aloud.

Yellow requires cutting the green wire, which is wire position 2. Both established codes identify position 2 as ✌, and Blind requests exactly one code symbol; therefore I will send only that symbol.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The previous instruction was correct, and the bomb has changed. I have no new light, display, or wire information to apply, so I cannot safely send another instruction yet.

``` 
wait()
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Correct cut. New state: display 0; light blue; wire 1 yellow, wire 2 cut, wire 3 blue, wire 4 red, wire 5 white. Please determine the next required action and convey it to Blind.
Blind says to Mute: First cut was correct. New state: display 0; light blue; wire 1 yellow, wire 2 cut, wire 3 blue, wire 4 red, wire 5 white. Consult the manual and gesture exactly one established code to Deaf: thumbs-up=wire 1, victory=wire 2, horns=wire 3, raised palm=wire 4, stop palm=wire 5. Deaf must relay the selected position aloud.

The blue light requires cutting the white wire. The white wire is at position 5, and Blind’s established code for wire 5 is ✋. I will send exactly that code to Deaf so it can be relayed aloud.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋"])
```
